title: Combining Observational and Experimental Data to Improve Efficiency Using Imperfect Instruments
eligible_reason: Methodological paper on combining experimental and observational data with imperfect instruments (GMM); simulations and an Expedia ranking application (position effects with random-flight experiment). No DiD.
design_notes: Code/functions/Estimation.R: OLS, IV (felm) and combined GMM estimators; Expedia_Nonlinear.Rmd for the application.
data_files_note: Expedia train.csv must be downloaded from Kaggle (Ursu 2018); not shipped.
data_provenance_note: Public Kaggle data, not included in the package.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); screened from README, regression inventory, main-results code and OpenAlex abstract. Out of scope.
